verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents its own tool system for mid-conversation calls: server-side webhook tools that call third-party APIs for real-time information, client-side tools, custom JavaScript run in a sandbox on ElevenLabs' infrastructure, and connections to external MCP servers. Nothing in the evidence addresses how the agent avoids dead air while a tool runs. The generic low-latency claims and the user-silence settings are not about tool-call latency. missing for 10: documented filler speech or latency masking during tool execution, evidence of how tool results are spoken back, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Tools give your assistant the ability to make external function calls to third party apps so you can get real-time information.
allow an assistant to trigger authenticated actions based on the conversation, like scheduling meetings or initiating order returns
Tools executed directly on the client-side application (e.g., web browser, mobile app).
Custom JavaScript executed in a sandboxed environment on ElevenLabs' infrastructure.
Enable agents to call clients & APIs to perform actions
